Pursuant to the aforesaid order, parties have appeared before the Sub Divisional Judicial Magistrate, Baghapurana and got their statements recorded.

On the basis of the statements so recorded, learned Judge has submitted report dated 09.12.2024 to the effect that the compromise has been effected between the parties voluntarily and without any coercion or 5024 12.13 16:16 undue influence.
Learned State counsel as well as counsel for respondent No.2 have not disputed the factum of compromise between the parties.
5. In view of the above, no useful purpose would be served to continue with the proceedings before the trial Court in the instant FIR.
